lines.text: Our robot weighs sixty kilograms. To speed up at ten meters per second squared, something has to push it with six hundred newtons.
That push only comes from the floor, through four tires. About one hundred fifty newtons each.
A tire can only grip so hard. On carpet, about as hard as the robot's weight presses it down. Push past that, and the wheel just spins.
And a spinning wheel lies. It counts distance the robot never moved, so the robot thinks it's somewhere it isn't.
Each wheel reaches its grip at about fifty-seven amps. Our motors could pull three hundred sixty. So the current limit is only a ceiling. The code has to plan with physics.
